import 'package:xberg/xberg.dart';

Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final inputs = await Future.wait((jsonDecode(r'[{"kind":"uri","uri":"pdf/fake_memo.pdf"},{"kind":"uri","uri":"text/fake_text.txt"}]') as List<dynamic>).map((element) => createExtractInputFromJson(json: jsonEncode(element))));
    final result = await XbergBridge.extractBatch(inputs);

  } finally {
